People are everywhere. The lines are typically long, but you are in and out. No matter how long the lines are, you are moving. Typically, all lines are open as well.I didnt grab a whole lot since I had just visited a Trader Joe's a few days before going to TN.Great location.Nov 5, 2025Updated reviewI love Joe's their products are awesome saucing! I have been going to Joes for years!!!This Joes is a bit small, and in a busy spot, but it truly is worth venturing in. And what a pleasant surprise!Lots of seasonal surprises, whipped sweet potatoes, pumpkin and spice items, cranberry goodies,wines, arrays of nuts, seeds,cheeses, florals, scents, doggie Advent calendar, cards, samples, chocolate, mints, and on, and on and on!Oh their Fearless flyer online is a real hoot, sign up, venture in!The flyer is entertaining, has a lot of good recipes, and product information.Dec 20, 2020Previous reviewI absolutely love Trader Joe's...it has great products an awesome prices! Truly! I am a native Oregonian and have been fortunate to have had Joe's for years and have been blessed to see it move East with me.Joe's products are exceptional, as are the folks that work there.We love this Joe's and are thankful we don't have to drive to Greenville SC ...Please venture in and get enchanted.Jan 28, 2018Previous reviewI love Joes...don't get me wrong but Knoxvilles location is in a poor spot...very small store...and always ravished...But dang, I over look that, for the excellent excellent product...and the produce is better than any store in the TN area... Always helpful, friendly service...all around the country! Consistent...I challenge anyone who loves FOOD to shop there first...you'll thank me...And sign up online for their funky flier...May 20, 2017Previous reviewLove me some Joes!!! Glad when Knoxville got a Joes...then moved to Charleston SC...Joes there friggin AWESOME...now we go to Knoxville...it is much smaller...and ravished most of the time...but damn...it has great stuff...Oct 29, 2016Previous reviewI love love love Joes...GREAT place to get good food for a Great price...This Joes has been out of items often...not use to that... but believe it is because of demand...and because once you go to Joe's your hooked..Holidays are coming and.. Damn ,Joes has awesome specialty products...Sign up for their crazy flier...for sales and it is an amusing to read...wasabi almonds rule...their produce last longer, and is fresher than any other southern outlet...Trader Joe's is super crowded but when they have what you want it's great. I have been to a ton of different TJ's and for some reason they are all cramped and don't always have tons of the items you may want because they have so many different things.I loved the peanut butter Joe Joe's they had back in the 90s-early 2000s (they used to make them in CA), but they have never heard of them out here - this TJ's is newer than the ones back home.The people who work there are nice and will show you where you need to go if you ask (and know what you are looking for before you go in).I've been here a few times since I moved to the area. If you like candles they have the best candles that you can actually smell when they are burning. The employees are always friendly. Makes sue you know when you buy breads and baked items that they don't have preservatives in them, so they will get moldy. Their hummus and pretzels thins work great together also.Should you go here? Yes. Not much more to say. :-) Unique products at good prices and friendly service. They often give my kiddos suckers or stickers. Tasty wine, tons of vegetarian options and produce galore. I am in love with their fresh flower section. You can grab a bouquet, but they have a wide variety of flowers and greens to create your own masterpiece.This Trader Joe's is always busy. The selection if food is well stocked. The people working there were constantly adding to shelves and facing products for ease of customers. Definitely a busy location but worth a stop to pick up some needed dinner supplies.The parking lot is being redone and unfortunately it was left a mess on a day it was pouring rain. However, the staff went above and beyond to help people to their cars. I appreciate the help extra because I was also juggling a baby. Big thanks to Tony for helping me get my cart through the rough parking lot and loaded in the rain.Nothing against TJ's personally but this location is AWFUL!! Parking is a nightmare and too many people trying to get in and out makes it difficult and stressful.I love Trader Joe's! It has great food and service. I like their frozen food and their baked goods their ice cream is very good. Their cold cuts and cheese are very tasty. Their fresh flowers are beautiful and their holiday decor is always very nice. And their food is reasonably priced.Loved this TJ's enough that I came back twice in the same day (never mind that's because I forgot something the first time). But seriously, who doesn't love Trader Joe's? Anyone? Anyone? Didn't think so. This location has easy access, good parking, spacious store, good produce, nice wine & beer selection, excellent variety of nuts & seeds... all my TJ faves. I even bought a Blarney Scone Irish Soda Bread after a complimentary sample served with Irish Kerrygold butter. Yes, I'm a sucker. I'm sorry one bit about that. Oh... And the staff I interacted with were all super friendly. I'm going back tomorrow!I love this Trader Joe's and think you might too. Until next time...
